text.p: Italian debt markets were in reverse by the close of trade after a marathon sprint higher in in recent days, but dealers said the tone of the market remained positive as optimism over EMU convergence continued.
Profit-taking proved too great a temptation, sending the September futures contract on LIFFE down 27 basis points to 134.31 after hitting a fresh record high at 134.84 earlier.
The February 2007 BTP was also 27 basis points down after forging its own record peak at 100.45 earlier. The spread over the benchmark Bund was 117 basis points, not quite at Thursday's 111 record.
